data.narrative:
Revere operates in the Defense & Security sector at an undisclosed stage. The comparable universe consists of 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic. In total, 26 same-sector peers exist across the investment landscape.

Peer-median valuation analysis is not applicable in this case. Despite identifying 26 Defense & Security companies, the peer set lacks sufficient depth at comparable stage, investment stage proximity, or valuation tier to support a reliable median multiple. Zero same-stage comparables, zero adjacent-stage comparables, and zero similar-tier private companies met screening thresholds. A methodologically sound peer median requires at least three datapoints within a narrow band; this threshold was not met. An all-sector median would introduce substantial noise and bias.

The analysis cannot produce a triangulated valuation range without executable comparables-based anchoring. Valuation of Revere would require either: (1) obtaining disclosed financial metrics (revenue, EBITDA, or growth rates) to apply earnings or revenue multiples from the broader Defense & Security peer set; (2) identifying additional undisclosed private financing rounds at comparable stage and valuation tier; or (3) employing alternative methods such as discounted cash flow analysis with disclosed forward guidance. Current data insufficiency precludes quantitative synthesis.
